q: How do gas molecules move?
a: Randomly, in all directions, at high speed

q: How does a gas cause pressure?
a: Molecules collide with the walls; force ÷ area = pressure

q: Why does adding more gas raise the pressure?
a: More molecules → more collisions per second → more force per unit area
